deploy-bot: Deploy queued — concurrent deploy limit reached for production. Environment: production. Ref: tag v2.14.3 (commit cdef123). Reason: 3 active deploys. Position: 3 of 5. ETA: ~12m. If this is low-priority, cancel to free slot. /status: https://deploy.redwood.internal/queue/1845627890
maria: ack, thanks. This is the hotfix for billing retry, needs to go after canary.
aj: can we cancel 1845610001? it's an old sandbox deploy. @ops-bot any objections?
ops-bot: Noted. That deploy is running integration tests; ETA ~9m. If you cancel it'll rollback the test run.
sophie: @maria is this safe to wait? user-facing? 
maria: yes user impact on retries, but can tolerate ~15m. Keep in queue.
kenji: I'll reroute non-prod bursts to staging to free capacity.
aj: @deploy-bot cancel 1845610001 please — older pipeline; priority low.
deploy-bot: Cancel request received for 1845610001. Attempting cancellation...
deploy-bot: Cancellation succeeded. Slot freed. Position updated: you are now 2 of 4 in queue.
maria: sweet, thx.
ops-bot: Heads up: if queue stays >2 for >20m we auto-fallback to elastic workers (higher cost).
aj: ok to proceed with canary after deploy finishes? prefer manual gating.
maria: manual canary ok.
deploy-bot: Starting deploy for 1845627890 -> production on host-pool-3. Tag: v2.14.3. Started by maria at 1845627960. Logs: https://deploy.redwood.internal/logs/1845627890
kenji: monitoring dashboards warming up :eyes: 
ops-bot: Canary health checks passing (3/3) — 1m
sophie: LGTM :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished SUCCESS. Duration 120s. Release notes: https://notes.internal/release/v2.14.3
maria: rolling pin to dedicated customers in 30m window. will post update to #announcements.
aj: nice, good job.
